What is the best alternative to HireVue?

JustInterview.ai is a leading HireVue alternative for TA teams that want structured AI-conducted interviews with real evaluation output. Unlike HireVue's one-way video recording format, JIA's AI actively conducts the interview — speaking structured questions while the candidate responds on camera — scores every candidate on multiple dimensions, and delivers transcripts and evaluations automatically.

How much does JustInterview.ai cost compared to HireVue?

JustInterview.ai starts at a one-time $2.99 for a full-access trial, then $9.99/month for Solo and $19.99/month for Team. HireVue is enterprise-only and does not publish pricing publicly.
